2610.08732.title: A Systematic Study of Semantic ID Spaces for Generative Information Retrieval
2610.08732.paper_summary: Generative Information Retrieval (GIR) has emerged as a transformative paradigm, shifting document retrieval from a traditional "retrieve-and-rank" workflow to sequence-to-sequence generation, where a model directly predicts document identifiers (DocIDs). While the semantic design of these DocIDs is known to be critical for performance, a fundamental question remains under-explored: what makes a good DocID? Current approaches rely heavily on computationally expensive downstream evaluations, hindering systematic analysis and rapid iteration. In this work, we address this challenge by presenting a comprehensive study on the properties, metrics, and trade-offs that define effective numerical DocIDs. Specifically, our contributions are threefold: First, we propose a unified framework that unifies Product Quantization (PQ) and Residual Quantization (RQ), and their hybrid variants within a single design space. This enables us to systematically study key DocID properties, such as hierarchy versus parallelism, as well as the impact of hyperparameters like DocID length and codebook size. Second, we define a suite of training-free, intrinsic metrics, to quantify DocID quality and evaluate structural fidelity without the overhead of full model training. Through extensive experiments on MS MARCO 300K and NQ320K, we analyze how these structural properties influence retrieval effectiveness.
2610.08732.paper_summary_zh: 生成資訊檢索（GIR）已成為一種變革性的範式，將文件檢索從傳統的「檢索和排名」工作流程轉變為序列到序列的生成，其中模型直接預測文件識別碼（DocIDs）。雖然這些DocIDs的語義設計被認為對性能至關重要，但一個基本問題仍然未被充分探討：什麼樣的DocID才算好？當前的方法在很大程度上依賴於計算成本高昂的下游評估，這妨礙了系統分析和快速迭代。在這項工作中，我們通過提出一項全面的研究來解決這一挑戰，該研究探討了定義有效數值DocIDs的屬性、指標和權衡。具體而言，我們的貢獻有三個方面：首先，我們提出了一個統一框架，將產品量化（PQ）和殘差量化（RQ）及其混合變體統一於單一設計空間中。這使我們能夠系統性地研究關鍵的DocID屬性，例如層次結構與並行性，以及超參數如DocID長度和詞典大小的影響。其次，我們定義了一組無需訓練的內在指標，以量化DocID質量並在不需要完整模型訓練的情況下評估結構保真度。通過在MS MARCO 300K和NQ320K上的廣泛實驗，我們分析了這些結構特性如何影響檢索效果。
